name: Blaye

limits: Carmenère and Petit Verdot together: at most 15%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

blurb.text: A right bank Bordeaux area on the Gironde around the town of Blaye, for red wine. Its rules allow Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Cot, Carmenère and Petit Verdot.
